name: Aquaguard Enrich Booster UV
summary: Aquaguard Enrich Booster is an advanced inline UV water purifier designed for municipal water (TDS up to 200 ppm).
intro: The Aquaguard Enrich Booster is a premium inline UV water purifier designed specifically for municipal water with TDS up to 200 ppm. Featuring 8-stage purification, NanoPore Filter Technology, and 3-in-1 Patented Active Copper Technology, it effectively removes bacteria, viruses, chlorine, and harmful contaminants while enriching water with the right amount of copper. Its 2-year filter life and additional Mega Sediment Filter ensure long-lasting performance, making it a reliable, low-maintenance solution for safe and healthy drinking water.
features: Suitable for Municipal/Soft Water (TDS up to 200 ppm)
8-Stage UV Purification with 99.9999% bacteria & 99.99% virus reduction
NanoPore Filter Technology for advanced contaminant removal
3-in-1 Patented Active Copper Technology for healthier drinking water
Mega Sediment Filter extends filter life by removing dust and dirt
